handoff.salientSummary: Built Sites /reserve and /reserve/manage, the profile Upcoming reservations panel, the Book a table website block, the operator Requests tab with channel badges, 6-locale translations, and both carried-over App fixes. I drove it end to end in agent-browser on acme (EN, US 3007) and riyadh-grill (AR RTL, KSA 3009). Sites vitest, typecheck, lint and check-lingui pass; commit 05659c95.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Sites: /reserve (gated by App /resources/sites/reservations, no-store, SSR shell with no guest data) with search, slot chips grouped by service, hold countdown, details form with honeypot, confirmation with 8-char code, .ics and #t= manage link. Also large-party contact/request modes, voice-hold resume via #h=, and release of the hold on leave. /reserve/manage reads the token from location.hash, stores it in sessionStorage and strips the fragment; it handles view, modify, cancel, confirm, running-late and .ics. Profile Upcoming reservations panel and signed-in prefill, ReservationBlock.astro (button/inline), middleware/cache headers, labels JSON block, and 6-locale .po (en, ar, es, fr, de, zh). Added randomUuid fallback for non-secure origins (crypto.randomUUID is missing on http://acme.menuza.test) and a region-based phone example (+1 for US, +966 for KSA) wrapped in bidi isolates. App/common (heavy subagent, then verified): reservation block (site-link, block-types, builder gated on reservations.online, AI chat, reserved slugs reserve/experiences), Requests tab with approve/decline, channel badges, requested/declined labels. Carried-over fixes: (a) header Date control and Jump to Today use the service-day business date and settings.dayStartMin; (b) Lingui breadcrumbs plus 16 ar.po strings.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: The ReservationBlock.astro rendering on a published Sites page was not browser-verified: it needs a publish, and the builder preview iframe returns 404 Organization not found in this environment. It is only covered by astro check, lint and code review. The hold-expiry-at-zero path and the VAL-CROSS-009 3-minute hold_minutes flow were not run live (only unit tests for the hold math, plus verified release on 'Change time'). No live reflow (table block) run for VAL-CROSS-006; the guest side was confirmed by inspecting the GET /reservations/manage JSON, which has no table ids or auto_reassigned events. VAL-CROSS-007 and VAL-CROSS-010 (restarting tenant-api) were not run. Non-English Sites locales other than ar were not browser-checked; es, fr, de and zh are covered by the label tests and check-lingui only.
